description: Labelled code blocks, signatures that link to their source, and text diagrams.

# Code

A fenced code block's info string is `lang [label] {meta}`. The label is shown above the code,
and it names the tab inside a code group:

```ts [app.tsx]
router.use(await gutenbeargModule({ watch: true }));
```

Every block gets a copy button. That one is written as:

````md
```ts [app.tsx]
router.use(await gutenbeargModule({ watch: true }));
```
````

To show a fence inside a code block, open the outer block with more backticks than the inner one
uses, as above. Inline code works the same way: `` ```ts [app.tsx] `` is written with two
backticks on each side.

## Signatures

A block in the `signature` language with a path as its label renders as an API signature. If
`site.sourceBase` is set, the path becomes a link to the source:

````md
```signature [gutenbearg/module.tsx]
function gutenbeargModule(options?: GutenbeargOptions): Promise<GutenbeargModule>
```
````

```signature [gutenbearg/module.tsx]
function gutenbeargModule(options?: GutenbeargOptions): Promise<GutenbeargModule>
```

## Diagrams

A block in the `diagram` language draws chains of nodes, one chain per line. `a -> b` joins two
nodes, and `a -[label]-> b` labels the edge:

```diagram
write -[edit]-> current version -[inherit]-> older versions
```

````md
```diagram
write -[edit]-> current version -[inherit]-> older versions
```
````
